title: Hide All Measurements joins the Measure menu so the menu and the panel menu offer the same set
goal: The Measurements panel menu can show all, hide all, copy the spec list and clear, but the Measure menu in the menu bar is missing Hide All. Someone working from the keyboard has to open the panel for the one command. The two menus should offer the same commands in the same order.
notes: Sources/Photonz/EditorCommands.swift:329 (Measure menu: Measure Tool, Copy as Spec List, Copy Measurement, Show All Measurements, Clear Measurements) against the panel menu in Sources/Photonz/LayersPanel.swift (MeasurementsSectionAccessory: Show All, Hide All, Copy as Spec List, Clear). EditorState.setAllMeasurementsVisible(false) already exists. Same shape as the capture-menu naming task finished 2026-09-02.
acceptance: In the Next release with next-measure-panel on, the Measure menu lists Show All Measurements and Hide All Measurements together, each disabled when it would change nothing, and Hide All is one undo step.
The panel menu and the Measure menu list their shared commands in the same order with the same names.
Copy as Spec List in the Measurements panel menu is disabled while every row is hidden, matching the Measure menu, so it never copies a bare header (audit 2026-09-02-copy-confirmation rough 2).
Scripts/test.sh green; audit written under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task.
docs/design/next-measure.md section 6 states the rule this fixes an instance of: a panel menu never offers a command the menu bar lacks, and both call it by one name.

log.note: folded in the panel-menu Copy as Spec List gap from audit 2026-09-02-copy-confirmation (triage 2026-09-02)
folded in: write the panel-menu mirror rule into next-measure.md while fixing this instance (digest design review 2026-09-02: third command-surface drift task in 24 hours)

adversarial review (before): the panel used short names (Show All / Hide All) and the menu bar long ones; picked the long form for both so the rule (one name) holds and the panel is consistent with its own Clear Measurements. Considered a chord for Hide All: cmd-H is Hide app and Show All has none, so neither gets one. Copy Measurement stays menu-bar only since it acts on the selection, not the document; the rule is one-directional.
acceptance 3 (panel Copy as Spec List disabled when every row is hidden) had already shipped in 44c9eeb; verified by reading LayersPanel.swift, nothing to change.

shipped: EditorCommands.swift Measure menu now Measure Tool | Show All Measurements, Hide All Measurements | Copy as Spec List, Copy Measurement(s) | Clear Measurements, each disabled when a no-op; LayersPanel.swift MeasurementsSectionAccessory menu renamed to the same names, same order, same disabled rules; docs/design/next-measure.md section 6 carries the mirror rule.

verified: swift build clean; Scripts/test.sh 1284 tests green; probe app opened a generated three-measurement fixture (one hidden) without error; enable logic checked in all four states (one hidden, all hidden, all shown, none) with a PhotonzCore script. Accessibility automation and screencapture are both denied to this shell, so the menus were not photographed.

adversarial review (after): the change is small and reads right in code; the one thing still worth a human eye is whether the longer panel names feel padded. Filed nothing: the rough items are judgment calls for the audit, not defects.

Measure menu now lists Show All / Hide All Measurements together, then Copy as Spec List and Copy Measurement, then Clear; the Measurements panel menu uses the same names, order and disabled rules (Sources/Photonz/EditorCommands.swift, LayersPanel.swift). Mirror rule written into docs/design/next-measure.md section 6. Verified: swift build, Scripts/test.sh 1284 green, probe opened a three-measurement fixture and the enable logic was checked in all four states; screenshots not possible from the loop.
